ravi (PM): quick sync 1. launch completed overnight. need a fast triage for post-launch issues and decide hotpatch vs mini-wave handling. doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/quick/2.1-postlaunch

sasha (Eng): noticed a spike in 5xx from the streaming proxy. opened ENG-2156. stack shows possible NPE after kvcache refactor.

tess (QA): ci started failing on flaky test 'stream-reconnect' after deploy. added logs to ENG-2157 and a short repro.

noah (Analytics): i'll publish a tiny dashboard for streaming-5xx, p95 latency, and session-drop. current 5xx ~0.8% and trending upward.

ana (Product Ops): typo in name above, sorry -- ana (Product Ops): i propose a 36h adaptive hotpatch window: immediate hotpatch for P0/P1 with SLA impact, otherwise push to mini-wave. separate crash/regression vs product-asks.

sasha (Eng): agree with buckets. quick rubric suggestion:
```
If crash or data-loss -> P0 -> hotpatch
If >0.5% active-requests affected OR 2+ paying customers impacted -> P1 -> consider hotpatch
If perf degradation <20% -> P2 -> mini-wave
Feature/customer requests -> score by (revenue, frequency, engineering cost) -> backlog/mini-wave
```

ravi (PM): nice rubric. ana, can you own the customer scoring matrix and flag legal/regulatory accounts?

ana (Product Ops): on it. i'll ping AEs. proposed scoring: revenue tier (1-3), frequency (1-3), config complexity (1-3). final score = rev*2 + freq - costWeight. will upload sheet by EOD.

tess (QA): hotpatch gating: require guarded e2e and a prod canary smoke (min 2 hours) before full rollout. also capture test-guard artifacts.

sasha (Eng): agreed. prefer canary with 30m minimum at P95 checks. release-bot: schedule canary if we cut 2.1.1.

release-bot: canary scheduled: 2.1.1-canary at 2024-10-05T04:30:00Z (job id: 9201).

noah (Analytics): i'll wire alerts: 5xx > 0.5% for 10m and p95 latency > 600ms -> post to #incidents and mention product oncall.

ravi (PM): timeline proposal: today = triage + label (p0/p1/p2) + customer-tagging; +6h = owners estimate; +18h = decision: cut hotpatch if low-effort and high-impact; else queue for sprint mini-wave.

ana (Product Ops): :thumbsup: i'll tag tickets with 'cust-urgent' and 'cust-suggestion' and include AE notes.

sasha (Eng): :thumbsup: i'll take ENG-2156 and post an estimate in 5h.

tess (QA): :thumbsup: i'll run the guarded suite once PR is up.

ravi (PM): thanks all. i'll add a short checklist to the launch doc and move labeled tickets into the hotpatch column if we go that route. please keep updates on the ticket threads only.
